single_framework_candidate_gate: A framework candidate must freeze one recipe and evaluate it on iv_only, anchor_only, and joint. Allowed differences are input/output dimensionality, support transforms, input heads, decoder heads, generic support-aware mixed discrete-continuous heads selected by one data-derived rule, and deterministic channel/group balancing. Scope-specific losses, loss weights, backend, prior, sampler, calibration layer, factor-name-specific sparse heads, or glued separately sampled decks are not allowed for a framework claim.

backend_switch_policy: Do not switch AR/one-shot, flow/diffusion/copula, or Transformer/other backbone until required audits classify the failure as backend failure rather than data framing, reconstruction, conditionality, diversity, dependency, or distribution shift.
research_axis_policy: Change one axis per iteration unless diagnostics prove coupling. Axes: data_object, output_law, temporal_factorization, backend, encoder, dependency_structure, calibration.
literature_search_policy: Search papers/official sources during diagnosis when a failure class repeats twice, a methodology/backend/encoder/temporal switch is considered, a normalization failure is not understood, local fixes are exhausted, or model limitation is about to be claimed.
